rejection.name_requires_both_languages: A name is required in both Arabic and English. The missing one is {missing}.
rejection.code_malformed: "{code}" is not a valid code. Use letters, digits, dots, dashes or underscores.
rejection.metadata_entry_too_long: The metadata entry "{key}" is too long.
rejection.date_malformed: {field} is not a date. Use the form YYYY-MM-DD.
rejection.country_code_malformed: "{country}" is not a two-letter country code.
rejection.language_tag_malformed: That is not a language tag.
rejection.date_of_birth_in_the_future: A date of birth cannot be in the future.
rejection.date_of_birth_implausible: That date of birth is too far in the past to be right. Check for a typing mistake.
rejection.person_merged: This record has been merged into another and can no longer be changed.
rejection.merge_is_not_a_status_change: Use the merge operation, which needs the record to merge into.
rejection.person_cannot_merge_into_itself: A person cannot be merged into themselves.
rejection.person_cannot_duplicate_itself: A person cannot be a duplicate of themselves.
rejection.document_reference_malformed: That is not a valid document reference.
rejection.identifier_expires_before_issue: An identifier cannot expire before it was issued.
rejection.identifier_withdrawn: This identifier has been withdrawn. Record the replacement instead.
rejection.nationality_already_held: This person already holds that citizenship.
rejection.email_malformed: That is not an email address.
rejection.telephone_malformed: That is not a telephone number. Include the country code, as in +966500000000.
rejection.priority_out_of_range: Priority must be between 1 and {limit}. 1 is called first.
rejection.address_requires_a_line: An address needs at least one line.
rejection.address_has_too_many_lines: An address has too many lines.
rejection.capability_level_unknown: "{level}" is not a level on that scale.
rejection.skill_requires_a_name: A skill needs a name in both Arabic and English.
rejection.years_out_of_range: Years of experience must be between 0 and {limit}.
rejection.field_of_study_only_on_education: A field of study belongs to an education record, not to a {kind}.
rejection.only_a_certification_expires: Only a certification expires. A {kind} does not.
rejection.record_already_withdrawn: That record has already been withdrawn.
rejection.duplicate_already_reviewed: This has already been reviewed as {status}.

conflict.person_number_taken: Another person already uses that number.
conflict.person_may_already_exist: Somebody matching this record already exists. Review the candidates, then create anyway if they are different people.
conflict.identifier_may_belong_to_another_person: Another person already holds an identifier of this kind with this value.
conflict.contact_may_belong_to_another_person: Another person already has this contact value.

reason.contact-value: The same email address or telephone number
reason.name-and-date-of-birth: The same name and date of birth

hint.nameHasHistory: A legal name has a history. Every name here is shown as it stood on the date above.

hint.noEmployment: This register holds no unit, position, manager, salary or attendance.
hint.duplicatesNeedReview: The system suspects these are the same human being. Nothing is merged automatically.
